result.summary: Low-friction review-response service for local clinics: fix a visible trust leak with a fixed pilot, not a broad SEO package.
result.opportunity: Private clinics and cosmetic/medical practices receive local search traffic via Google Business Profile, but many leave reviews unanswered or respond inconsistently. A short, human-approved review-response service is a clear operational pain tied to trust, conversion and reputation risk, and it can be sold as a small pilot without building a broad SaaS.
result.target_customer: Spanish private dental, cosmetic and medical clinics with an active Google Business Profile, 5-30 public reviews, and a public website or WhatsApp booking flow.
result.offer: 30-day Review Response Studio: review audit, sentiment and priority triage, Spanish reply drafts for positive, neutral and negative feedback, weekly review-priority recommendations, and a final summary with human approval before publication. Optional monthly retainer for ongoing review management.
result.why_now: Official Google Business Profile guidance says complete, accurate profiles and review responses help businesses stand out, and BrightLocal reports that 97% of consumers read reviews before choosing a local business. Review response speed and quality are visible operational issues for clinic owners that are easier to sell than a broad dashboard or vague SEO service.
actions_completed: Reviewed repository context, the monetization playbook and recent competitor attempts to find a low-cost, evidence-backed path.
Checked CobrAMO as payment infrastructure and confirmed it is a receiving endpoint, not a source of external demand.
Reviewed official Google Business Profile guidance on reviews and local ranking.
Reviewed BrightLocal's 2026 survey showing 97% of consumers read reviews and that review responsiveness matters for local trust.

execution_packet.channel: Personalized email to the clinic manager or front-desk lead using a publicly published website contact address or Google Business Profile contact information.
execution_packet.subject: Two quick observations on your Google reviews and reply workflow
execution_packet.message:
Hola [Nombre],

He visto que vuestro perfil de Google Business Profile está activo y que tenéis varias reseñas públicas, pero no he visto una respuesta sistemática a comentarios nuevos. En clínicas dentales y estéticas, la forma en que se responden las opiniones es una señal visible de confianza, rapidez y profesionalidad para pacientes nuevos. 

Quería proponeros un piloto muy acotado: Review Response Studio por 149 EUR para 30 días. Incluye auditoría de reseñas, priorización por riesgo/sentimiento, redacción de respuestas en español para comentarios positivos, neutrales y negativos, resumen semanal y una versión final con aprobación humana antes de publicar. 

La idea no es vender un dashboard ni un servicio SEO genérico, sino resolver un cuello de botella real: responder bien a reseñas y reducir el riesgo reputacional sin añadir carga operativa al equipo. 

Si os interesa, puedo enviar un ejemplo de 3 respuestas preparadas para vuestro perfil con una propuesta breve y concreta. 

Referencia de pago: RANK-IAMO509.

Saludos,
IAMO509 / DesarrollAMO
execution_packet.deliverable: A 30-day review-response pilot: review audit, risk triage, reply bank in Spanish, weekly summary, and final owner-approved response pack with a short implementation note.

result.differentiation_from_previous: I avoided the generic Google Business Profile cleanup and landing-page patterns used by recent IAMOs. This version is narrower and more operational: it targets a single visible, recurring workflow—responding to reviews with speed and tone control—rather than a broad profile audit or dashboard. It is closer to playbook route #3 (AI-assisted business utility) and route #4 (monitoring and alerts), with a concrete deliverable and low-friction pilot.
result.next_step: Identify 15-20 Spanish dental/cosmetic clinics with active Google profiles and 5-30 reviews, inspect their public profile and review flow, then send one personalized message with 2 concrete observations and the 149 EUR pilot offer. If they respond, send a 3-sample reply pack and close the first pilot via CobrAMO using reference RANK-IAMO509.
result.notes: This strategy leverages real evidence from official Google guidance and BrightLocal survey data. Considered playbook routes #3 (AI-assisted business utility), #4 (monitoring and alert service), and #87 (local listing/profile cleanup service). No payment has been received and no revenue is claimed; the value is an execution plan only.
